{{Top|leg}}
'''Karfeddion Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]]. It was filled with [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]], [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair businesses and shady [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

One of its many docking bays was [[Docking Bay 331]] where the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Arwen Cohl]] and his crew, [[Boiny]] and [[Lope (individual)|Lope]], rendezvoused with several members of [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group,<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref>
